correctness.rationale: For each F⊆E(K_n) in the Alexander dual, every three edges of F have at most one disjointness pair; equivalently the disjointness graph has maximum degree one. It follows exactly that F lies in a star simplex or within the six edges of K4. Designating vertex 0, the subcomplex with pairwise-intersecting non-0 edges admits an explicit fiberwise acyclic cone matching leaving one vertex (B=non-0 edges never increases along downward arrows). Each remaining K4 simplex P_S intersects this collapsible core in the join of three S0, an S2, and distinct P_S intersect only in the core. Hence dual≃wedge^{binom(n-1,4)} S3, and integral Alexander duality gives X_n homology only in degree N-6. Pure N-4 X_n therefore nonshellable. Independently computed exact nonempty dual-face counts (260,746,1750,3634) for n=5..8. These bounded checks corroborate, not replace, unrestricted proof.
